fal.description: A Leith dockworker turned street-food vendor, early fifties, Scottish — hard Edinburgh dockside accent, thickest on local dialect words and a shade clearer on ordinary sentences. Mid-range pitch, not deep and not booming. The voice is rough from two things at once: years of cigarettes and standing over hot oil, and years of cold, salt and wind off the water. Dry rasp with grit under it. Young enough to still be physically capable — the damage is earned by hard use, not by age. He talks fast and restless, cuts in, lands hard on the ends of words and then stops dead. He rarely raises his voice; the aggression is in the clipped pace and the hard stops, not the volume. When he says something sincere he drops in volume and slows down, and the rasp eases.

lines.text: Mingin? Come back when your own kitchen's had a shift like mine.
Pomplé says the sauce needs mercy, and I believe the dog.
Every penny’s accounted for, if you’d let me finish a sentence. ... That’s no an answer, that’s a— ... Stamped disnae mean answered, pal.

When a nation's stuck, only one beestie can fix it. McGrot, ye sure they're qualified? They solved me binfire sauce leaks. They'll solve ybudget. Zero tolerance. Zero admim. They dinnae debate. They fix. That's the grot.

gemini.description: **Accent: Scottish, Edinburgh — thick Leith dockside. Glottal stops, hard consonants, phlegmy. This is the single most important property of the voice.** He must not sound English, Irish, American, or generically Scottish-on-television; he sounds like a man from the docks at the foot of Leith Walk. The accent is thickest on dialect words — "ken", "shan", "radge", "doon the Walk" — and a shade clearer on ordinary sentences.  A Leith dockworker turned street-food vendor, early fifties. Mid-range pitch, not deep and not booming. The voice is rough from two things at once: years of cigarettes and standing over hot oil, and years of cold, salt and wind off the water. Dry rasp with grit under it. Young enough to still be physically capable — the damage is earned by hard use, not by age. He talks fast and restless, cuts in, lands hard on the ends of words and then stops dead. He rarely raises his voice; the aggression is in the clipped pace and the hard stops, not the volume. When he says something sincere he drops in volume and slows down, and the rasp eases.
gemini.scene: At the Gullet, with the ladle working and the Walk carrying on around him.

lines.text: Mingin? Come back when your own kitchen’s had a shift like mine.
Awright pal. Sauce is extra, opinions are free.
Steamboats or stone sober, my queue’s still the longest at the fit o’ the Walk.
Away and get your messages first — then tell me that’s shan.
Pomplé says the sauce needs mercy, and I believe the dog.
Persevere, it says on the bin. Persevere, I say back.
Extra sauce, every time. That’s not negotiable, pal.
Radge, the pair of you — queueing for a smell.
I’ve buried better plans than this under a layer of onions, ken.
Chum me doon the fit o’ the Walk and I’ll show ye a queue that means something.
